create_add_litellm_data_to_request: add LiteLLM proxy request data including headers, metadata, auth info, and guardrails to a request dict
build_clean_headers: clean request headers by removing LiteLLM API keys and filtering special proxy-only headers
run_add_guardrails_from_policy_engine: resolve and apply guardrails from the policy engine based on team, key, and model context
test_get_chain_id_from_headers: extract chain ID for call chaining from x-litellm-trace-id or x-litellm-session-id request headers
review_parse_cache_control: parse Cache-Control header string into a dictionary of cache directives and values
